text:
maria: Launch day check-in 2020Blog + benchmark live 10:00 PT. Monitoring press + socials for the next 4 hours. Can everyone confirm owning their lane? :rocket:

press-bot: Publish detected: https://redwood.com/blog/optimize-launch (10:00 PT) \u2014 automated social push queued.

emily: I'll watch tier-1 press and compile clips into the tracker. If anything looks like a factual error ping me and i'll escalate.

ben: Social templates ready. I'll queue the first wave at T+15 and the second wave at T+60. Need final CEO quote and one short stat for the hero card.

maria: CEO quote pinned in assets: "Optimize brings predictable, production-grade inference with clear unit-economics." Short stat: "up to 3x token throughput in real workloads" (as per benchmark).

olivia: Heads-up: NYTimes pulled a version with an altered phrasing on the cost stat. Link: https://nyti.ms/3xyzabc \u2014 says "10x" which is incorrect. They're a must-fix.

emily: Thanks, saw that. I'll add it to the error column and reach out to the reporter directly. Does PR want a correction note or a re-quote?

maria: Start with a polite correction email offering the corrected stat + methodology link. If they push back escalate to legal. cc: @olivia @legal-bot.

legal-bot: Suggested correction language (short): "Correction: Our benchmark shows up to 3x token throughput improvement in the tested workloads; we have updated the methodology here: https://redwood.com/assets/optimize/methodology-v1.2.pdf" Approve?

olivia: Approve. Also offer on-the-record time with the CEO for context. That usually helps.

ben: Social hold for NYTimes until correction confirmed. I'll substitute a generic product link in UK-targeted posts.

press-bot: Journalist outreach logged: reporter=nyt_reporter@nyt.com status=contacted method=email timestamp=1803001120

emily: Reporter replied: "Thanks, we'll correct in the next update." I'll monitor and close.

maria: Good. Two other items: (1) tracking shortlinks are all published? (2) any inbound demos or interviews we need to staff?

ben: Shortlinks done and in the tracker (column: partner_shortlink).

olivia: We've got a request from Wired for a follow-up interview next week; i'm taking that. Also received a ask from a fintech outlet for a technical drilldown 2020assign to research?

emily: Assign to @olivia for editorial, and @maria for product POV. Research can provide bench clarifications if needed.

maria: Perfect. Last thing: please add any press pull quotes you want featured in the press kit to the folder. I'll coordinate a quick update if we get more corrected mentions. :thumbsup:
